---
name: meeting-follow-up
description: Turn meeting notes into a concise follow-up with decisions, actions, and open questions.
---

# Meeting follow-up

Use only information present in the supplied meeting notes.

1. Summarize the outcome in no more than three sentences.
2. List confirmed decisions separately from open questions.
3. Record each action with its owner and due date when provided.
4. Mark missing owners or dates as `Unassigned` or `Not specified`.
5. Never infer commitments, attendees, or deadlines.
6. End with the next decision or input required.
